name: Quanta Computer Inc.
summary: Quanta Computer Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing, processing, and selling laptop computers in the United States, Mainland China, the Netherlands, Japan, and internationally. The company offers notebook PCs; servers, including high level blade servers, rack servers, server motherboards, LAN cards, storage, networking switches, etc.; IoT products; HD encoding cameras; and industrial computers. It also designs and manufactures wireless communication products, including mobile phones, tablets, wearable products, smart speakers, and other smart home products; wireless devices and modules for system integrators and end uses, such as SiP modules for handheld devices, PCI-E modules for notebook computers, mini-PCI modules for embedded applications, and Card bus cards and USB dongles for end users; and multimedia products comprising home gateway, IP-STB, DMA, and audio products. In addition, the company designs, manufactures, and markets global positioning system (GPS) products, including GPS engine boards, GPS mouse, Bluetooth GPS, GPS data loggers, GPS speed camera detectors, personal navigation assistance, and Pico projectors, as well as wireless communications and software solutions. Further, the company offers datacenter products and services that include storage, network switches, integrated rack systems, and cloud solutions; and planning, installation, and implementation of factory automation, as well as engineering, integration, and optimization services. Quanta Computer Inc. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.
